title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Inconsistent modulus formula in GNSS fallback chain
description: Line 162 defines CCP-12 as '1 + (Hash MOD N)' where N = MAX(NChannels, 3), but line 259 in the GNSS fallback chain uses '1 + (FNV1A32(Seed || SFN) % (N-1))'. These produce different channel ranges (1..N vs 1..N-1). If both describe the same synchronized hopping algorithm, the formulas must match.
